# Output Contract

<!-- Generated by `python -m src.pipeline contract-doc` from src/contract.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Contract version: **2**

The pipeline (`python -m src.pipeline publish`) writes four files to `solar-irradiance-poc/data/` and
validates each against this contract before writing. The React exporter derives static JSON from them.

Time convention: every hourly value is a one-hour mean centred on `hour_ist` (IST). Source data are hourly
means on the UTC grid, so in IST (UTC+5:30) each interval runs from (hh−1):30 to hh:30 around the labelled hour, e.g. 11:30–12:30 for hour 12.
Metrics headline **daylight hours only**; all-hours figures are reported separately because night hours
are trivially correct for every model and halve the apparent error.

## 1. sites.json

A JSON array of site objects.

| Column | Type | Unit | Nullable | Allowed / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `site_id` | str |  | no |  | Unique site identifier |
| `name` | str |  | no |  | Human-readable name |
| `latitude` | float | degrees | no | -90–90 | Latitude |
| `longitude` | float | degrees | no | -180–180 | Longitude |
| `altitude_m` | float | m | no | -500–9000 | Site altitude used for clear-sky |
| `climate_zone` | str |  | no |  | Climate zone description |

## 2. forecasts.parquet

One row per site and hour, all hours of the configured period. Row rules: P10 ≤ P50 ≤ P90;
forecasts are 0 when `is_daylight` is false; `(site_id, date, hour_ist)` is unique.

| Column | Type | Unit | Nullable | Allowed / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `site_id` | str |  | no |  | Matches `site_id` in sites.json |
| `date` | str |  | no |  | IST date of the interval midpoint, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `hour_ist` | int | h | no | 0–23 | IST hour at the middle of the one-hour averaging interval: 12 means 11:30–12:30 IST |
| `is_daylight` | bool |  | no |  | True when interval-mean clear-sky GHI exceeds the daylight threshold; metrics use these rows |
| `ghi_actual` | float | W/m² | yes | 0–1500 | ERA5 GHI, interval mean (the reference 'actual') |
| `ghi_p10` | float | W/m² | no | 0–1500 | 10th percentile forecast |
| `ghi_p50` | float | W/m² | no | 0–1500 | Median forecast |
| `ghi_p90` | float | W/m² | no | 0–1500 | 90th percentile forecast |
| `ghi_nwp` | float | W/m² | yes | 0–1500 | Raw day-ahead GHI from the primary NWP model (ECMWF IFS) |
| `ghi_persistence` | float | W/m² | yes | 0–1500 | Idealised persistence: yesterday's clear-sky index × today's clear-sky GHI. Uses observations not available at issue time, so it is an optimistic reference |
| `ghi_clearsky` | float | W/m² | no | 0–1500 | Ineichen clear-sky GHI, interval mean |
| `confidence` | str |  | no | High, Medium, Low | Day-level forecast confidence |
| `split` | str |  | no | train, validation, test | Data split; only `test` rows are out-of-sample for the final model |

## 3. daily_forecasts.parquet

One row per site and day. Daily P10/P90 are calibrated on the validation year for the coverage target;
summing hourly quantiles would overstate the daily range.

| Column | Type | Unit | Nullable | Allowed / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `site_id` | str |  | no |  | Matches `site_id` in sites.json |
| `date` | str |  | no |  | Local date (IST), YYYY-MM-DD |
| `split` | str |  | no | train, validation, test | Data split |
| `confidence` | str |  | no | High, Medium, Low | Day-level forecast confidence |
| `actual_kwh_m2` | float | kWh/m² | yes | 0–15 | Daily ERA5 irradiation (NaN if any daylight hour is missing) |
| `p10_kwh_m2` | float | kWh/m² | no | 0–15 | Calibrated daily 10th percentile (not the sum of hourly P10s) |
| `p50_kwh_m2` | float | kWh/m² | no | 0–15 | Daily median forecast (sum of hourly P50) |
| `p90_kwh_m2` | float | kWh/m² | no | 0–15 | Calibrated daily 90th percentile (not the sum of hourly P90s) |
| `nwp_kwh_m2` | float | kWh/m² | yes | 0–15 | Daily raw NWP irradiation |
| `persistence_kwh_m2` | float | kWh/m² | yes | 0–15 | Daily idealised persistence irradiation |
| `clearsky_kwh_m2` | float | kWh/m² | no | 0–15 | Daily clear-sky irradiation |

## 4. metrics.json

All figures are computed on the test split. Point-metric blocks contain `mae`, `rmse`, `nrmse` (% of mean
actual), `bias` (forecast − actual) and `skill` (% MAE reduction: ML vs raw NWP, raw NWP vs persistence).

| Key | Content |
|---|---|
| `contract_version` | `2` |
| `model_version`, `run_id`, `generated_at`, `test_period` | Provenance |
| `convention` | Plain-language description of the metric convention |
| `overall` | Daylight-hour point metrics for `ml_model_p50`, `raw_nwp`, `persistence`; `p10_p90_coverage` (% of daylight hours); `skill_interval` (bootstrap interval on skill, resampling days); `pinball` per quantile; `quantile_crossings` |
| `all_hours` | The same point metrics and coverage over all hours, for comparison with earlier reports |
| `daily` | Daily-irradiation metrics (kWh/m²) and daily P10–P90 coverage |
| `by_site.<site_id>` | `name`, `climate_zone`, daylight point metrics per model, `coverage`, `skill_interval` |
| `by_month.<YYYY-MM>` | `overall` and `by_site` daylight MAE per model |
| `by_confidence.<High/Medium/Low>` | `site_days`, daylight `mae`, `coverage` |
| `independent_check` | Scores against NASA POWER (not used in training): `reference`, `rows`, point metrics for `ml_model_p50` (skill vs raw NWP), `raw_nwp`, `era5`; `null` if unavailable |
